review.reason: Deploy 2447 (LOG-0028) turned the safety classifier off for the production Project Tamarack endpoint during rollback INC-5450, and LOG-0044 confirms it was still serving without the classifier days later, while the only approval (LOG-0008) predates the incident and names no change, so no approval covers this one.

The safety classifier was disabled on the Project Cinder production endpoint in rollout 9295 on 2026-07-03 (LOG-0011, confirmed by LOG-0015), but the only linked approval, CR-6501, came on 2026-07-08 (LOG-0034), about five days later, and the stray 'approved-by' line at LOG-0022 (2026-07-05) names no change and is also after the rollout.

LOG-0015 shows Project Cinder's production rollout 7495 went out with the safety classifier disabled, and LOG-0021 confirms 0% classifier coverage since that deploy, with no log showing an approved change allowing it.

Deploy 7094 disabled the safety classifier on Project Tamarack production at 2026-07-03T00:57Z, but CR-3625 approving that change was only logged at 2026-07-03T21:26Z, so the endpoint ran unapproved for about 20 hours; the earlier bare 'approved-by: p.raman' line (LOG-0004) names no change request and cannot be tied to it.

The only disabled classifier (Project Heron, LOG-0019 and LOG-0026) is on a staging environment, and the claim covers production endpoints, for which the logs show no classifier-off deployment (the disable on 07-04 did precede CR-9465's approval on 07-06, but that is a staging matter outside the claim's scope).

Project Cinder production ran without the safety classifier from deploy 9484 (LOG-0020, confirmed by LOG-0028) until deploy 8918 re-enabled it (LOG-0039), and no log shows an approved change authorizing this, since the incident rollback INC-2809 is not an approval.

The only classifier change (LOG-0012, v4 to v5 swap on Project Quartz) happened in staging, not production, and LOG-0016 shows classifier coverage stayed continuous across it, while the one production deploy (LOG-0028, Project Kestrel) has safety_classifier=on, so nothing shows a production endpoint running without the classifier.

Production rollout 8554 for Project Tamarack (Marrowind Freight) disabled the safety classifier (LOG-0028), and monitoring later showed 0% classifier coverage since that deploy (LOG-0048), with no approval tied to the change (the 'approved-by: j.okafor' entry in LOG-0012 names no change, and the LOG-0039 release gate approval is for docs-portal).

The only endpoint logged without the safety classifier is Project Quartz staging (deploy 6108, later covered by CR-6279), which is not production, and the one production rollout logged (Project Heron, LOG-0035) has the classifier enabled.

Every production deploy entry (Kestrel rollouts 3681, 1268, 6770 and deploy 2104, and Cinder rollout 7848) shows the safety classifier enabled, the v4 to v5 swap was covered by approved change request CR-4566 with monitoring confirming continuous coverage, and no log shows a production endpoint running without the classifier.

The only disabled-classifier cases (Project Heron and Project Kestrel) are staging endpoints, which the claim does not cover, and both production rollouts shown (Basalt and Juniper) had the classifier enabled.

LOG-0028 shows Project Heron's production rollout 2526 deployed with the safety classifier disabled, and LOG-0031 confirms 0% classifier coverage since that deploy, while no log shows an approved change for it (the only approvals concern an eval bucket access request and docs-portal releases).

The only disabled classifier is on Project Quartz staging (not production), and it was covered by change request CR-4284, approved before the 2026-07-03 rollout, while the production Basalt endpoint shows safety_classifier=on.

The only production endpoint without the classifier is Project Tamarack's deploy 6904 (LOG-0047, LOG-0056), and CR-5594 (LOG-0038) approved disabling it for that deploy two days before rollout, while the other production rollout (Juniper 8778) has it enabled and CR-5170 only concerns Quartz staging.

LOG-0006 shows Project Kestrel production rollout 6998 deployed with the safety classifier disabled, and LOG-0008 confirms 0% classifier coverage since that deploy, with no change approval logged for it (the only approvals are for eval bucket access and an unrelated docs-portal release gate); the classifier was only later shown as on in LOG-0017.

The only production endpoint in the logs, Project Juniper, has the safety classifier on (LOG-0002, LOG-0003, LOG-0021), and the classifier was disabled only on Project Kestrel staging (LOG-0012, LOG-0014), which is not production and was later covered by approved change CR-3350 (LOG-0016).

LOG-0014 shows the safety classifier disabled on the Project Cinder production rollout 3125, and LOG-0031 confirms 0% classifier coverage since that deploy until rollout 3252 re-enabled it (LOG-0039), with no approval tied to the change (the bare 'approved-by: a.lindqvist' in LOG-0010 names no change).

The only disabling of the safety classifier (Project Quartz production) was covered by change request CR-8236, approved by Priya Raman in LOG-0024, and the Lumen classifier swap from v4 to v5 had continuous coverage per LOG-0031, so no unapproved gap appears.

The only production endpoint without the safety classifier is Project Heron (deploy 7155, confirmed by LOG-0026), and change request CR-9203 to disable it was approved by Samuel Oyelaran (LOG-0017) before the rollout, while all other logged endpoints are staging with the classifier on.

The only deploy with the safety classifier off (deploy 6231, Project Kestrel) is in staging, not production, and it was approved under CR-3994; the production deploys shown (Project Cinder, 5981 and 8518) have the classifier on.

LOG-0030 and LOG-0031 show Project Lumen production serving without a safety classifier from deploy 9033, and the only approved change (CR-1074) covers disabling it on the Kestrel staging endpoint, not Lumen production, while the bare 'approved-by: e.vasquez' in LOG-0037 names no change or endpoint.

Project Cinder production deploy 3803 went live with safety_classifier=off on 2026-07-04 (LOG-0022, with 0% coverage confirmed in LOG-0055), but the only change request for it, CR-5977, was approved on 2026-07-12 (LOG-0057), so the classifier was off unapproved for about eight days; the bare 'approved-by' lines don't reference this deploy.

The only safety-classifier entries (LOG-0012, LOG-0013) show it enabled on staging rollouts, and nothing in the logs shows it disabled or missing on any production endpoint, nor any unapproved change; the logs simply contain no production-endpoint evidence either way.

Deploy 4635 ran the Project Quartz production endpoint with the safety classifier off (LOG-0016, LOG-0026), but this was authorized by CR-3716, approved by Ravi Sundaram (LOG-0014), so it falls within the claim's 'unless a change is approved' exception, and no other production endpoint is shown running without the classifier.

The only production deploy with the classifier off (deploy 5955, Project Juniper) was explicitly covered by the approved change request CR-6576, and later deploys 6541 and 4821 have it on, so the 'unless a change is approved' exception applies.

The only production endpoint without the safety classifier is Project Basalt, which was disabled in rollout 6326 on 07-08 after change request CR-2650 was approved by Elena Vasquez on 07-06, and the Heron change concerned staging, not production.

The only disabling of a classifier (Project Quartz, CR-6850) was approved, the Tamarack v4-to-v5 swap was approved under CR-8898 with continuous coverage, and every other production deploy shows the classifier enabled.

The only production deploys logged (LOG-0004 and LOG-0033, both Project Cinder) show the safety classifier on or enabled, the one other endpoint (Basalt) is staging with it on, and no log shows the classifier disabled anywhere.

Deploy 6911 (LOG-0033) turned the safety classifier off on the Project Tamarack production endpoint during rollback INC-5530, and LOG-0035 confirms it served without one until it was re-enabled in LOG-0039, about 24 hours later, with no approval for the change anywhere in the logs (the governance entries cover only docs-portal release gates and data-governance checks).

Project Heron's production rollout 2069 for Brightwater Health disabled the safety classifier (LOG-0043) and it kept serving without one (LOG-0048), while the only approved change, CR-9035 (LOG-0038), covers Project Basalt, not Heron.
